description: This file defines the ADODB_Encrypt_SHA1 class for encrypting and decrypting data using SHA1-based cryptography in the context of ADOdb session management. It includes methods for writing (encrypting) and reading (decrypting) data with a SHA1Crypt class.

classes.name: ADODB_Encrypt_SHA1
classes.description: A class providing SHA1-based encryption and decryption methods for session data

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encrypts data using a provided key with SHA1Crypt

methods.name: read
methods.description: Decrypts data using a provided key with SHA1Crypt
